Mechanism: hand-120-cap-2
How: one operator keeps at most 2 live lantern keys, so 10 fakes need 5 separate hands, not 10.
Cost: each extra key locks 1.1, must finish 2 graded tasks each epoch, burns 0.4 on a miss, and waits 4 epochs. The 5 hands must be awake in the same signal window, which money cannot buy.
Check: the lotus close counts distinct live hands for epoch 120, not whether the task text was right.
